parameters.query:
SELECT
  COUNT(*)                                                    AS c0_total_ativos,
  SUM(fup_valido)                                             AS c1_fup_parseavel,
  SUM(fup_valido AND fup_vencido)                             AS c2_dash,          -- ~1300 esperado
  SUM(fup_valido AND fup_vencido AND nao_parceiro)            AS c3_mais_tipo,
  SUM(fup_valido AND fup_vencido AND nao_parceiro
      AND wa_ok)                                              AS c4_mais_whatsapp,
  SUM(fup_valido AND fup_vencido AND nao_parceiro
      AND wa_ok AND spa_ok)                                   AS c5_mais_status,
  SUM(fup_valido AND fup_vencido AND nao_parceiro
      AND wa_ok AND spa_ok AND unico)                         AS c6_mais_dedupe,
  -- controles
  SUM(NOT fup_valido)                                         AS x_fup_nao_parseavel,
  SUM(fup IS NULL OR fup = '')                                AS x_sem_fup_invisivel_no_dash
FROM (
  SELECT
    m.id, m.fup,
    (DATE(m.fup) IS NOT NULL)                                 AS fup_valido,
    (DATE(m.fup) < CURDATE())                                 AS fup_vencido,
    (m.tipo IS NULL OR m.tipo <> 'Parceiro')                  AS nao_parceiro,
    (
      m.whatsapp IS NOT NULL AND m.whatsapp <> ''
      AND LENGTH(w.loc) BETWEEN 10 AND 11
      AND w.loc <> REPEAT(LEFT(w.loc,1), LENGTH(w.loc))
      AND CAST(LEFT(w.loc,2) AS UNSIGNED) BETWEEN 11 AND 99
    )                                                          AS wa_ok,
    (
      m.status_plano_acao IS NULL OR m.status_plano_acao = ''
      OR m.status_plano_acao NOT IN (
        'ptentativaderreativaçãor','stentativadereativaçãor',
        'ttentativadereativaçãor','encaminhar advisor','naoeoICP')
    )                                                          AS spa_ok,
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM mailing m2
      WHERE m2.lixeira = 0 AND m2.id <> m.id
        AND CONCAT(LEFT(m2.wl,2), RIGHT(m2.wl,8)) = CONCAT(LEFT(w.loc,2), RIGHT(w.loc,8))
    )                                                          AS unico
  FROM mailing m
  JOIN ( /* aplica aqui as CAMADAS 1+2 de limpeza de telefone da query2 → alias w(loc) */ ) w
    ON w.id = m.id
  WHERE m.lixeira = 0
    AND /* tem_operacao = 'Não', com os 5 caminhos da query2 */ 1=1
) t;
